Classification

Disorders due to substance use or addictive behaviours

CIE-11: block 6C40–6C5Z · look up in ICD-11 ↗
DSM-5-TR: Substance-related and addictive disorders

They group problems due to substance use and addictions without a substance. The classifications distinguish between harmful use, which is already causing damage, and dependence, in which control over use is lost, use becomes a priority and tolerance or withdrawal appear. DSM-5-TR uses a single category, "substance use disorder", graded from mild to severe.

ICD-11 includes gaming disorder; DSM-5-TR only mentions it as a condition requiring further study. Both include gambling. Addictions are treatable, and primary care and addiction services are the way in.

What it includes

  • Disorders due to use of alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, opioids, sedatives, cocaine, stimulants and other substances
  • Intoxication and withdrawal
  • Gambling disorder
  • Gaming disorder
